## SettingsSetResourceClient.get() method

Read the settings set identified by `name`<!-- -->. When several settings sets share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used, and the operation does not fail as ambiguous.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(name: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<SettingsSet>;
```
